questions.stem: Where is Ian Sierra from?
opts: Suzhou.
Beijing.
California.
Shanghai.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据”a group of students from a school in California”可知，Ian Sierra 来自美国加利福 尼亚。故选C。

questions.stem: Which part did Sierra like best about the trip?
opts: Trying some local food.
Traveling alone in China.
Visiting many places of interest.
Joining an exchange and homestay program.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据”the part he liked best about the trip was the exchange and homestay (家庭寄宿) program”可知，Sierra 最喜欢的部分是参与交换和家庭寄宿项目。故选D。

questions.stem: What was Gong Siyong’s idea about the differences among students from the two schools?
opts: He found there was no difference at all.
He thought there were too many differences.
He respected the differences and tried to find more similarities.
He thought it was difficult to accept the differences though he tried hard.
questions.expl: 态度题。根据”We have more similarities than differences, and those differences can be understood”可知，他尊重差异并努力寻找共同点。故选C。

questions.stem: How did Sierra’s feelings change before, during and after the trip?
opts: Nervous→excited→thankful.
Excited→surprised→thankful.
Excited→thankful→surprised.
Nervous→surprised→thankful.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据”he felt nervous before the trip”可知，Sierra 出发前是紧张的；根据”Sierra and his friends were excited”可知，Sierra 旅行中是兴奋的；根据”He was thankful for the trip”可知，Sierra 回 家后是感激的。Sierra 的感情变化为Nervous→excited→thankful。故选A。

questions.stem: What can we infer (推断) from the passage?
opts: Sierra’s friends behaved well in China.
The exchange students stayed in Beijing for a week.
Sierra’s new plan was to be an English teacher in China.
Gong Siyong and Sierra met again in Beijing after the trip.
questions.expl: 本文是一篇记叙文。讲述了美国加利福尼亚的学生Ian Sierra 参加中国教育文化交流项目 的经历，包括他的感受、收获以及未来计划的变化。

questions.stem: King Zhao asked Guo Wei for advice in order to _________.

buy the bones of a qianlima at a lower price
get more talented people to work for his state
offer Guo a job and treat him nicely

questions.stem: What was the man's reason for buying bones of a dead horse? _________
opts: There's no time for him to find a live qianlima.
Horse owners would see the king's need for qianlima.
Bones of a dead qianlima are better than common horses anyway.

questions.stem: The underlined phrase "let alone" is similar to _________.
opts: needless to say
no less than
on one's own
let it go
questions.expl: 猜测题。根据“You are willing to pay a high price for a dead horse, let alone a live one. This shows people you truly wish to buy the horses. ”你愿意花高价买一匹死马, ……一匹活马了。这表明 你真的想买马。根据语境，猜测划线部分的含义为“更不用说”。故选A。

questions.stem: According to the passage, Guo Wei _________ in the story he told.
opts: compared himself to the bones of a dead qianlima
imagined himself to be the horse owner
expected the king to provide a house for him

questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Guo told the king that he could see himself as the bones of the horse. ”可知，在故 事中郭隗把自己比作死了的千里马的骨头。故选A。

questions.stem: We can learn from the story of buying bones with 500 pieces of gold that _________.
opts: it is impossible to buy a live qianlima for 500 pieces of gold.
there is little need to recommend (推荐) yourself
it is of great importance to value talented people sincerely
nothing is more important than short﹣term interests
questions.expl: 本文主要讲了战国时期郭隗用千里马的故事告诉燕昭王招纳贤才的办法。

questions.stem: Which of the following best describe Gianni?
opts: He enjoys reading.
He is a clever student.
He can remember well.
He connects what he sees.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“Gianni says that his “gift”, or special ability, he has memorized more than 250 books!”可知，Gianni 的记忆力很好，记住了250 多本书。故选C。

questions.stem: What can be learned from some research on memory?

questions.stem: Why did Gianni memorize books?
opts: To study brain science.
To develop his memory.
To improve his knowledge.
To prepare for historical tests.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“The same idea is true for Gianni. ”和“Since the age of 11, he’s been training his brain to remember more and more. He practices continuously to improve the power of his memory. ” 可知，记住这么多本书，是为了提高他的记忆力。故选B。

questions.stem: Which is the best title of the passage?
opts: The Memory Man
An Unforgettable Memory
Mental Athletes
Special Power to remember
questions.expl: 本文主要介绍了Gianni 是一个记忆力很好的人，经过科学家的研究发现，人们可以通过 练习和锻炼大脑来提高记忆力，Gianni 对此表示赞同。

opts: Because the cat was lost in the thick grass
Because the cat looked dirty and might be hungry

Because the cat couldn’t find its way home

opts: She disliked living in the village of Kentucky

questions.stem: What did Du Mengran do during her college years?
opts: She started her own deep-sea exploration company.

questions.stem: Why did Fern run out to see her father after talking to her mother?
opts: To see the newborn pigs.
To have breakfast with him.
To help him with the farm work.
To stop him from hurting the small pig.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Please don’t kill it!”可知，她的目的是阻止父亲伤害小猪，故选D。

questions.stem: Which is the correct order of what happened in the story?①Fern ran out of the house quickly.②Fern was setting the table with her mother.③Mr Arable returned with the pig in a box.④Fern argued with her father about the pig’s life.
opts: ②④①③
④②③①
②①④③
④①②③
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“said Fern to her mother as they were setting the table for breakfast. ”可知，Fern 和母亲一起准备餐桌；根据“Fern pushed a chair out of the way and ran outdoors. She caught up with her father. ”可知，Fern 得知小猪将被杀死后，快速跑出房子；根据“‘Control myself?’ shouted Fern. ‘This is a matter of life and death, but you talk about controlling myself. ’ Tears (眼泪) ran down her cheeks and she took hold of the ax and tried to pull it out of her father’s hand. ”可知，Fern 追上父亲并争论小猪 的生命问题；根据“Half an hour later, Mr Arable returned to the house, carrying a box under his arm. ” 以及“There, inside, looking up at her, was the newborn pig. ”可知，Mr Arable 返回时带着装小猪的盒 子。因此，正确顺序为②①④③，故选C。

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes Fern’s character as shown in the text?
opts: Shy and quiet.
Gentle and calm.
Curious and playful.
Strong-willed and kind-hearted.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“‘Control myself?’ shouted Fern. ”可知，Fern 大声抗议坚持阻止父亲杀死小猪， 并流泪争论“生命与死亡”的公平性，这体现了她意志坚强；同时，她同情弱小生命显示心地善良。 故选D。

questions.stem: What is the best title for this passage?

questions.stem: Why did Timmy feel proud after meeting Rolo?

Because he learned how to make tea better.
Because he could make friends with the robot.

questions.expl: 理解题。根据“They met a kind robot named Rolo, who taught them how to plant trees and recycle. ‘It’s important to care for our Earth!’ Rolo said with a smile. Timmy felt proud to learn all these wonderful things. ”可知，罗洛教给蒂米如何种树和回收利用，让蒂米学会关心并保护地球，因此他 感到自豪。故选D。

questions.stem: What’s the correct order of the following events?a. Timmy received a letter.b. Timmy visited ancient Egypt and the future.c. Timmy returned home and shared his adventures.d. Timmy met Hansel and Carl under the old pine tree.
opts: a-b-d-c
a-d-b-c
d-a-c-b

questions.stem: What can we learn about Nikola Tesla?

questions.stem: Why did Tesla’s teachers worry about him in university?

questions.stem: Why does the writer mention the company Tesla in the last paragraph?
opts: To show us the achievements of Tesla.
To make an advertisement of the car company.
To show that Tesla’s ideas are still important today.
To catch readers’ attention with a modern example.

questions.stem: What does the article mainly talk about?

The development of electricity in the world.

It can also damage and weaken the shell over time. ”可知，老妇人给乌龟刷去附着在壳上的藻类等脏东西，这是对乌龟的帮助。故 选B。 31. 细节理解题。根据“Anything on a turtle’s shell, like algae (藻类) or dirty things reduces the turtle’s ability to take in heat from the sun as well as its ability to swim. ”可知，藻类会降低乌龟吸收阳光热量 的能力。故选C。

questions.stem: Why did Shang Yang place the wooden pole at the gate?
